name: Harshal Deshpande
email_source: ROS Discourse hiring post by Peppermint staff
subject: Winter internship at Peppermint Robotics | Pranav, IIT Bombay
why_line: Robots that map a building and find their way around it on their own are the problem I enjoy most on the driverless team, and I'd love to see how it's done in a real product.
body:
Hi Harshal,

I'm Pranav, a second-year Electrical Engineering student at IIT Bombay. My winter break runs from the last week of November to the first week of January, and I'd love to spend those six weeks learning with the team at Peppermint Robotics.

A bit about me: I'm on IIT Bombay Racing's driverless team, where I help the car work out where it is on the track, and I'm doing a minor in AI and Data Science. I'm also part of a small student venture building low-power sensors that flag floods and fires early, and last winter I spent the same break interning with Ankur Warikoo's team at WebVeda.

Robots that map a building and find their way around it on their own are the problem I enjoy most on the driverless team, and I'd love to see how it's done in a real product.

I'm happy to pitch in wherever I can be useful. My resume is attached, and I'd love to chat if this sounds like a fit.

Best,
Pranav Jaju
IIT Bombay | +91 88069 22758
